name: We Are Tanks
summary:
Welcome to We Are Tanks — a fast-paced, arcade-style multiplayer VR game where you become a sleek, neon-lit battle tank and fight for one thing: kills.

No time limits. No complicated rules. Just hop in, blast other players, and climb the scoreboard. It's raw, retro-fueled action in a glowing synthwave arena where every hit matters and style is everything.

🎮 Features:

🎯 Kill-based multiplayer mayhem — rack up the most takedowns

🌌 Retro synthwave aesthetic with glowing grids and thumping beats
